appendix.authoring_note: definition, raw_source, units, default_behavior, higher_value_meaning and known_caveats are intentionally blank. They are claims about the domain, not properties derivable from the model, and inventing them would produce documentation that reads as authoritative and is not.

identity.comparator_note: The market's own implied probabilities on the same races. This is the right comparator for the production model because the model is built as a correction to it: the booster learns a residual on log(market_prob), so the market is the baseline by construction, not a chosen benchmark.
identity.label: Bagged Offset (production)

delta_semantics.definition: model race log loss minus market race log loss, paired by race

run.refusal_note: Refusals are recorded rather than omitted, so a reader can see the strategy was considered and declined. Rebate-aware sizing cannot reuse stale bankroll-dependent fractions on a divergent path.

refused.reason: rebate_aware_sizing makes the Kelly threshold fraction depend on the current bankroll, so fractions solved on the historical path are stale on any simulated path that diverges from it. Reusing them would give confidently wrong risk numbers biased in an unknown direction. Re-solve per replicate or exclude this strategy.
